text:
We got our approval from bituach leumi a couple of months ago when i was 31 weeks pregnant. However, our initial request was rejected because they said it was missing a signature. When we checked the form, the signature they were referring to was not relevant for us. Rather than arguing with them, we just submitted the form again, and this time it was accepted. Sometimes you just fall on a clerk who doesn’t know the system.
Maybe try submitting it again and see if you land on someone else?
